scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @shop-things/interface dev" "pnpm --filter electron dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @shop-things/db build && pnpm --filter @shop-things/interface build && pnpm --filter electron build:main
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm --filter electron exec electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm --filter electron exec electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: pnpm build && pnpm --filter electron exec electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm --filter electron exec electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.fix: nub run lint:fix && nub run fmt
